The '''Gungan Staff''',<ref name="Hasbro" /> also called a '''staff of authority''', was owned by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]],<ref name="Ultimate" /> who led the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] on<ref name="Hasbro" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Gungan Trouble" /> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Staff/Legends|staff]] was [[Color/Legends|black]] and had two triangular supporting branches at the bottom, which had holes next to the body of the staff. The tip of the staff held a roughly circular shape with a symmetrical pattern of holes throughout it. The center of the tip contained three round teal objects.<ref name="Hasbro" /> 

Nass held the staff when<ref name="Gungan Trouble" /> he<ref name="Hasbro" /> [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] the clumsy Gungan [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] from the [[Gungan Swamp]] for causing too many accidents. During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]<ref name="Gungan Trouble" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Nass raised the staff at the [[Gungan Sacred Place]] in front of a crowd of Gungans who had evacuated Otoh Gunga following the Trade Federation's [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|siege]] of the city.<ref name="Gungan Trouble" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan Staff was first revealed when it was included as an accessory for the Boss Nass action figure in [[Hasbro]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I (toy line)|''Star Wars: Episode I'' toy line]],<ref name="Hasbro" /> released in [[May]] [[1999]].<ref name="Insiders">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> The staff then first appeared in the [[2000]] ''[[Star Wars Junior]]'' picture book ''[[Gungan Trouble!]]'', written by [[Liza Baker]] and illustrated by [[Jerry Vanderstelt]].<ref name="Gungan Trouble /> The staff was identified as a staff of authority in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Action Figure Collection]]'' by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]].<ref name="Ultimate" />
